body:
You may have read about my involvement in a fascinating network of African leaders called Amahoro. (My book Everything Must Change includes several stories….) I just learned yesterday that there is still room for a small number Western guests (US, UK, Europe, etc.) at this year’s gathering – May 21-25. We Westerners who come truly are guests – the real focus is on the African leaders and their context, but I can assure you that you will be challenged and your vision expanded in remarkable ways, and you will meet some wonderful people – like these friends from Amahoro:

 Amahoro from Integral Mission on Vimeo .

 You can learn more here:

 http://www.amahoro-africa.org/amahoro_africa/amahoro-gathering-2012-1.html

If your heart and curiosity are sparked … maybe you should come?
